主要内容: Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc. entered into a Separation and Release Agreement with Rian Furey on August 14, 2019. Mr. Furey, who served as Chief Operating Officer and President of Direct Lending, will have his last day of employment on August 16, 2019. The Company will pay him a severance payment of $250,000 in two equal installments on September 11, 2019, and November 11, 2019. Mr. Furey will not be eligible to receive a bonus with respect to any portion of the Company’s 2019 fiscal year. All unvested stock options will be forfeited and vested stock options will remain exercisable until the earlier of November 14, 2019 and the expiration date of such stock option. Mr. Furey holds options exercisable for 10,000 shares of common stock at an exercise price per share of $9.99.
